# The DLL names each file of the Windows set holds for run-time loads: every whole string that ends
# in .dll or equals a base name the policy knows, outside the export name, the version resource, the
# certificate table, the PDB path and the import names. Each file's rows must equal what it holds,
# ignoring case, so a new LoadLibrary target fails verification until a reviewed edit here. One row
# per file and string: <file> <string>, the string the rest of the row. python3 -I
# tools/lib/windows_policy.py rows <set-dir> <driver> policy runtime-names prints them.
